name: Carved stone relief
material: limestone, marble, sandstone or other carveable stone on a retained backing plane
fabrication_process: finish or pigment as context requires
edge_behavior: Contour edges remain tied to a backing plane; silhouettes do not become fully free-standing except in very high relief.
color_behavior: Stone color/pigment depends on material/period; depth is communicated by relief and directional light more than painterly gradients.
surface_behavior: Backing plane, carved recesses, worn protrusions and deposits share continuous stone behavior.
composition_behavior: Favor profile/three-quarter narrative overlap, readable depth hierarchy and raking light that reveals carving.
structural_limitations: no fully round statue masquerading as relief
aging_weathering: cracks/losses cross relief and backing material coherently

prompt_fragments.core: Compress the scene into a carved depth hierarchy attached to a stone backing plane; use raking light to reveal chisel facets, raised contours and worn high points.

typical_generation_failures: looks like a grayscale photograph embossed by a filter
evaluation_criteria: light reveals physical carving rather than fake bump map

sources.supports: limestone relief, carved modeled details, pigment traces, wear/damage behavior

scope_note: This module controls material/production behavior. It does not select an era by itself.
